description: Get a measure (or several, with concepts) over time, newest first: latest (default), first reported, or as known on a filing date, with its filing, other version and yearly change.

as_of.description: A filing date, not a period end: only filings made by then count.

basis.description: latest (default), first_reported, or as_of (default with as_of).

concept.description: Plain name (revenue, eps_diluted, assets; follows tag changes) or XBRL tag (Revenues).

unit.description: Default: the unit with most periods.
